'''Vinya Maysor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked for [[Viceprex/Legends|Viceprex]] [[Karrek Flim]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Maysor worked for [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] Viceprex Karrek Flim on [[Vreni Island]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Her office was in the back of a [[Vreni Island cantina|local cantina]].<ref name="AED" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], one of the Viceprex's underlings paid [[Slicer/Legends|data slicers]] to alter shipping documents to make the Viceprex seem incompetent and corrupt. To prevent damage to the Viceprex's reputation, she decided to employ a data slicer herself to alter records that would make the underling look like a fool instead. For this, she hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to deliver the [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]] to the slicer.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vinya Maysor is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. In the game, Maysor can be found in the cantina of the Vreni Island settlement where she offers a quest to players. This quest asks the player to deliver a datadisc to a slicer. However, players are unable to actually start the quest, because it was never fully implemented by the developers.
